description: This file provides type definitions for the Moment.js library, including function signatures, interfaces, types, and exported symbols. It is used for type-checking and IntelliSense support in TypeScript projects.

methods.name: declare function moment(inp?: moment.MomentInput, format?: moment.MomentFormatSpecification, str/ moment
methods.description: Function to create or parse Moment objects with variable inputs, supporting optional parameters for format and localization.

methods.name: moment.utc
methods.description: Creates a Moment object in UTC mode with specified input and optional parameters.

methods.name: moment.unix
methods.description: Creates a Moment object from a Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

methods.name: moment.invalid
methods.description: Returns an invalid Moment object, optionally with specific parsing flags.

methods.name: moment.isMoment
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a Moment instance.

methods.name: moment.isDate
methods.description: Checks if an object is a JavaScript Date instance.

methods.name: moment.isDuration
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Duration instance.

methods.name: moment.locale
methods.description: Gets or sets the current locale.

methods.name: moment.duration
methods.description: Creates a Duration object based on input.

methods.name: moment.parseZone
methods.description: Creates a Moment object parsing input in a specific timezone.

methods.name: moment.locales
methods.description: Returns a list of available locale names.

methods.name: moment.relativeTimeThreshold
methods.description: Gets or sets the threshold for relative time calculations.

methods.name: moment.relativeTimeRounding
methods.description: Gets or sets the rounding function for relative time.

methods.name: moment.calendarFormat
methods.description: Determines the calendar format based on the current time.

ctags.name: moment
ctags.pattern: /^declare function moment(inp?: moment.MomentInput, format?: moment.MomentFormatSpecification, str/
